plan.title: PR assignee list includes matching subcategory user

steps.note: Enable the required team-category filtering configuration before opening the PR list.
Open Purchase Requisitions, the starting screen for this PR-based case.
Stay on the Open tab where PR-1 is expected to be available.
Select the named open PR as the closest catalog action to selecting its line item.
Open the PR assignee picker using the assignment control described in the case.
Verify that the user search box and assignee list opened.
Scroll through the assignee list until the expected matching user is visible.
Assert that User B, the buyer whose team has the PR subcategory, appears in the assignee list.
